title: Rajiv Lochan Temple

buildingCutout.basis: Approximate mapped central Rajiv Lochan Temple roof.

terrainReference.basis: Original DEM height at the center of the mapped main block candidate.

mapIdentity.provider: Overture Maps building detection from Google Open Buildings, identified by the nearby protected monument point and Archaeological Survey dimensions.
mapIdentity.scope: One approximate mapped roof outline, the archaeological inventory platform and sanctuary dimensions, the exact 2005 Qualla original, and the original elevation field.

note: The raised platform follows the inventory dimensions. It carries a square stepped sanctuary tower with domed finial, a lime-plastered mandapa with carved posts, flanking stairs and the immediately adjoining low shrine.
